observations: Photo 0 shows a black game console with a boxy, two-tone top (textured left, glossy right) and a rounded circular power button on the right side — consistent with the original Xbox One design.
A caution/safety label is visible on the underside of the console in photo 0, text too small to read.
Photo 1 shows the same console with one black wireless controller held above it, showing the Xbox button, ABXY buttons, and D-pad.
No power adaptor/power brick is visible in either photo.
No game discs, cases, or storage/capacity label are visible in either photo.
No photo shows the console powered on or connected to a display.
Images are watermarked 'POSTED ON JIJI / NWODIKA SOMTO', consistent with a marketplace listing screenshot.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show the distinctive two-tone boxy shape matching the original Xbox One console.
Photo 1 shows one wireless controller held above the console.
No discs, cases, or game list are shown in either photo.
No adaptor is shown in either photo, so the nature or severity of the issue cannot be seen; only the seller's word is available.

risks.risk: Power adaptor may be missing entirely or faulty beyond simple wear, making the console unusable as-is.
risks.proof: Photo of the actual power adaptor/brick plus a video of the console powering on and reaching the dashboard.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / non-functional unit

risks.risk: Core console function (disc drive reading games, HDMI output, no overheating/shutdown) is unverified since no power-on is shown.
risks.proof: Video clip of console booting, loading a disc, and displaying video output on a screen.

risks.risk: The claimed 6 games (including FC) may not exist, may be digital-only, or may be scratched/unreadable discs.
risks.proof: Photo of the physical game discs/cases laid out, including the FC title.
risks.if_unproven: priced as console-and-pad only, games excluded

risks.risk: Storage capacity (500GB/1TB) is unknown and affects value.
risks.proof: Photo of the rear/bottom label showing storage specification.

risks.risk: Controller condition (joystick drift, button wear, battery compartment corrosion) is unverified beyond a static photo.
risks.proof: Video of controller sticks and buttons being used in-game or in the Xbox accessories app.

risks.risk: General cosmetic condition and internal wear (dust, fan noise, disc tray function) not shown from other angles.
risks.proof: Additional photos from top, rear ports, and underside close-up, plus fan noise video.
risks.if_unproven: priced as visible-condition only, no premium for unseen areas

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on with the actual adaptor to the dashboard screen.
Photo of the power adaptor itself, and a clear description/clip of the exact 'adaptor issue'.
Photo of the rear label showing storage capacity and serial/model number.
Photo of all 6 game discs/cases, including the FC title.
Video or photo of the controller's joysticks/buttons being tested.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as an Xbox One console with one controller, but the seller's own admission of an adaptor issue combined with no power-on proof means the unit must be priced at worst case as non-functional, with games and full accessory completeness unverified.
